title: Microsoft 365 admin center: set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN
summary: Hold: the cost discussion overlooks Microsoft's explicit statement that Office 365 CDN is included in the SharePoint Online subscription. The setup path and PowerShell command are documented, but the guarantees that existing tenants need no action and that only one role can enable Public CDN exceed the evidence.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let administrators set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN.
claims.quote: We are updating the Brand Center setup experience so that administrators can set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The roadmap describes Public CDN as previously enabled during setup even for branding governance capabilities that do not require it.
claims.quote: Today, Public CDN is enabled as part of Brand Center setup, even when an organization only wants to use branding governance capabilities that do not require it.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The planned change lets organisations defer Public CDN until they need dependent capabilities such as organisational fonts.
claims.quote: With this update, organizations can begin using Brand Center while deferring Public CDN until they need capabilities that depend on it, such as organizational fonts.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: No action is required otherwise, and nothing changes for any tenant that has already set up Brand Center.
claims.quote: Searched: Brand center optional Public CDN existing brand centers no action required rollout. Read brand-center-overview and roadmap record; neither states an unchanged-state or no-action guarantee for all already-configured Brand Centers.
claims.fix: Remove 'no action is required otherwise' from the summary. Replace 'If nobody does anything, nothing changes for tenants that have already set up Brand Center' with 'The roadmap describes a setup change; it does not specify an action for tenants that have already set up Brand Center.'

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Publishing brand fonts creates publicly stored catalog files alongside the fonts, accessible to people outside the organisation who obtain the URLs.
claims.quote:
The newly created font catalog files are publicly stored, along with the fonts, in the cloud
The files are accessible to anyone, even people outside of your organization, who can get the URLs that link to them.
